instruction.text: Look at the example sentence below and fill in the following gaps about the present perfect.

atoms.b: The present perfect tense is used when something happened in the ((++past present future)) and continues to affect the ((++present future)).

instruction.text: Which sentence is in the present perfect tense?

b: Leila listens to jazz music all the time.
++Leila has listened to jazz music all her life.
Leila used to listen to jazz music all the time.

atoms.a: Which helping verbs are used to form the present perfect tense?

end.text: To form the present perfect tense you need the helping verbs have/has + the past participle form of a verb.
end.sound: To form the present perfect tense you need the helping verbs. have. or has. plus, the past participle form of a verb.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps with the present perfect tense of the verb.

hint.text:
Remember: to form the present perfect tense you need the helping verbs have/has + the past participle form of a verb.

For example:
This has happened before.
hint.sound: Remember: to form the present perfect tense you need the helping verbs, have, or has, and the past participle form of a verb. For example: This has happened before.
